desktop.home: Plant It Home My Plants Add Plant Logout Welcome to Plant It Your personal plant identification and care assistant. Upload a photo to identify a plant, get care instructions, and keep an eye on its soil moisture. No hardware needed: every plant gets a simulated sensor you can water; a real ESP8266 takes over when you connect one. Identify a New Plant Upload a photo of a plant to identify its species and get care recommendations. Add New Plant View Your Plants See all the plants you've identified and their care instructions.
